description: §44.3 — a `.prepare()` on a `?{}` SQL result inside a top-level server `function` (route-inferred handler, called from markup) SHALL be compile error E-SQL-006. This pins the STRUCTURED AST lowering path (emit-logic `case "sql"`), distinct from the TEXT/regex path (rewriteSqlRefs): a real server-function body lowers through the structured emitter, so its `.prepare()` diagnostic must escape the server-fn body (since s456: via the run-wide refused-lowering sink drained by runCG; before, via a `preparedStmtErrors` channel each server-fn-body emit caller threaded). Before the fix this compiled clean (exit 0) and emitted only a runtime-throwing IIFE.
rationale: SPEC §34 catalogues E-SQL-006 as an Error emitted at compiler/src/codegen, and §44.3 mandates `.prepare()` on a `?{}` result be a compile error. The structured emitter records E-SQL-006 in the run-wide refused-lowering sink (refused-lowering-errors.ts) and still emits the runtime IIFE (defense-in-depth); runCG drains the sink into the live error stream.
